Ava (Marketing): Draft for the Optimize blog is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Key bits: short benchmark sentence, tiny embedding curl example, and CTA routing. Need legal + sales ok by EOD Wed so ops can schedule publish.

Diego (Content): Pasting minimal embed snippet for the post so readers can copy: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-mini","input":"Summarize Redwood Optimize benefits"}'
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass: remove hard numeric claims (e.g., "5x"). Replace with conservative phrasing like "dramatically lower per-token cost with batching and caching". Also reword SLA mentions to "where contracted". Approve after those edits.

Sam (Sales): CTA routing suggestions:
- Request a demo -> HubSpot form hb-210 (AE: enterprise queue)
- Try Hosted API -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth SDR)
- Demo webinar -> Eventbrite -> HubSpot list "Optimize Webinar" (tag: webinar_reg)
And ops note: if registrant.company_size > 50 AND role in ["Eng","Product","ML"], mark as high-priority and create AE task.

Ava (Marketing): Added CTA mapping and played the ops note into the playbook. I swapped the numeric claim per Nina and updated the caption to: "Latency and per-token cost measured on supported model variants; results vary by workload."

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS copy must match the doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved. I'll DM exact HubSpot field IDs to Ops.

OpsBot: Publish job queued for 2024-08-15T09:00Z. Final copy lock: 2024-08-14T16:00Z. If edits after lock, ping @ops.

Ava (Marketing): Great  pushing to CMS now and scheduling. Closing thread.
